name: Be The Biggest Verity
desc:
🟡 Eat. Grow. Evolve. 🟡

Start as a tiny Verity and roll around the arena eating orbs to grow 🍬 Get big enough and you can swallow other players whole 😋, but watch out 👀, because someone bigger is always hunting you.

😈 100+ Verities to unlock! As you grow, your Verity transforms into something stranger, scarier and more powerful. Can you reach ♾️ Infinity?

✨ Features
🍬 Eat orbs and players to grow from size 10 to numbers you can’t even read
⬆️ Level up to multiply how much every orb gives you
📖 Collect all 20 Verities in the Index, each with its own look and sound
🏆 Climb the leaderboard and show off your size
🚪 Exit safely to keep your size for next time

💡 Tips
🧍 Stand still for 5 seconds before leaving to save your size
🤖 Use Auto to farm orbs
💨 Bigger players move slower, so use your speed to escape

💀 Got eaten? Get revenge! 🔥

This game runs on a server authoritive model to prevent foul play

passes.name: Set Skin [Any Owned Verity, Any Time]

llm.loop: roll around the arena eating orbs -> grow in size and level up orb multiplier -> swallow smaller players while fleeing bigger ones -> unlock stranger Verity forms -> exit safely to bank size
llm.objectives: become the biggest player on the server and unlock all Verity forms in the index
llm.progression: size (from 10 to huge numbers), level-based orb multiplier, 100+ Verity transformations, index completion
llm.instructions: eat orbs and smaller players to grow, avoid bigger players, stand still 5 seconds before leaving to save size, use Auto to farm orbs
unique: agar.io-style eat-and-grow loop with evolving creepy smiley 'Verity' forms
must stand still to bank size before leaving
llm.thumbnails: colored smiley balls on a green baseplate, a huge dark scribbled Verity face looming over a small yellow smiley ('You are mine!'), showing the eat-and-grow chase
llm.complexity_notes: flat arena, sphere characters, orb spawning, size scaling and player-eating collision; simple UI
